overview_description.description:
Collibra delivers an end-to-end Data Intelligence platform to accelerate digital business transformation. Collibra accelerates trusted business outcomes by connecting the right data, insights, and algorithms to all Data Citizens. The company's platform breaks down traditional data silos and opens up organizational data, providing trustworthy business intelligence, enabling users to find the data they need, collaborate on it, and easily understand its meaning.

It was founded in 2008 and headquartered in Hoofdstedelijk Gewest, Belgium.

about_short_description.short_description: Collibra delivers an end-to-end Data Intelligence platform to accelerate digital business transformation.

product.name: Collibra Platform
product.description: A data intelligence platform for cataloging, governing, monitoring, tracing, protecting, and accessing enterprise data and AI assets.

product.name: AI Command Center
product.description: A control plane for structuring, operating, and overseeing enterprise AI systems through visibility, trust signals, traceability, and controls.

product.name: Data Governance
product.description: A governance solution for defining business terminology, rules, metrics, ownership, responsibilities, policies, and regulatory controls for enterprise data.

product.name: Data Catalog
product.description: A data discovery and understanding solution that organizes enterprise data assets with searchable metadata, context, and usage information.

product.name: Data Quality & Observability
product.description: A solution for monitoring data health, defining quality checks, detecting anomalies and schema changes, identifying root causes, and supporting remediation.

product.name: Data Lineage
product.description: A data lineage solution that visualizes data movement, transformations, dependencies, downstream impacts, and the lifecycle of enterprise data.
